units.literal: Radiant primal queen—you sprang from Yang.

units.zh: 奕世朱輪，燿彼華陽。
units.en: Generation on generation rode vermillion wheels—Huayang blazed.
units.literal: For generations vermillion wheels gleamed—Huayang blazed.

units.zh: 惟嶽降神，顯茲禎祥。
units.en: Sacred peaks poured forth spirit—showing these blessed omens.
units.literal: The peak sent down spirits—revealing these auspicious signs.

units.zh: 篤生英媛，休有烈光。
units.en: From them sprang a heroine blazing with light.
units.literal: Earnestly was born a splendid maid—she bore radiant glory.

units.zh: 含靈握文，異于庶姜。
units.en: Spirit and letters dwelt in her—not common flesh.
units.literal: She housed spirit and grasped pattern—unlike common Jiang brides.

units.zh: 和暢春日，操厲秋霜。
units.en: Gentle as vernal sun; resolve sharp as autumn frost.
units.literal: Gentle as spring sun; carriage stern as autumn frost.

units.zh: 疾彼攸遂，敦此義方。
units.en: She spurned reckless ease and upheld righteous paths.
units.literal: She hated those who rushed heedlessly; she cherished righteous rule.

units.zh: 率由四教，匪怠匪荒。
units.en: She walked the four teachings—never idle, never wild.
units.literal: She followed the four teachings—never slack, never waste.

units.zh: 行周六親，徽音顯揚。
units.en: Among six degrees of kin her sweet fame rang.
units.literal: She moved through six kinships—fair fame rose bright.

units.zh: 顯揚伊何？
units.en: Where did her praise ring?
units.literal: Where did that fame shine?

units.zh: 京室是臧。
units.en: It rang through the royal house.
units.literal: The capital chamber held her good.

units.zh: 乃娉乃納，聿嬪聖皇。
units.en: Courtship led her to the sage sovereign’s side.
units.literal: Betrothed and welcomed—she married the sage emperor.

units.zh: 正位閨閾，惟德是將。
units.en: She ordered inner gates—virtue guided every step.
units.literal: She rectified inner thresholds—virtue led her charge.

units.zh: 鳴珮有節，發言有章。
units.en: Her pendants chimed in rhythm; every phrase wore pattern.
units.literal: Jade pendants sounded with measure; speech carried patterned grace.

units.zh: 仰觀列圖，俯覽篇籍。
units.en: She studied charts above and rolled texts below.
units.literal: She looked up to illustrated charts; bent to scan texts.

units.zh: 顧問女史，咨詢竹帛。
units.en: She queried palace scholars and silk-bound histories.
units.literal: She consulted female scribes; asked counsel of bamboo and silk.

units.zh: 思媚皇姑，虔恭朝夕。
units.en: She charmed her royal mother-in-law with dawn-and-dusk reverence.
units.literal: She sought to charm royal mother-in-law—dawn and dusk reverent.

units.zh: 允釐中饋，執事有恪。
units.en: She governed inner kitchens—every duty performed with awe.
units.literal: She truly ordered inner kitchens—each task performed with awe.

units.zh: 于禮斯勞，于敬斯勤。
units.en: Ritual bent her back; reverence drove her nights.
units.literal: In ritual she toiled; in reverence she strove.

units.zh: 雖曰齊聖，邁德日新。
units.en: Though hailed unequaled, her virtue renewed each dawn.
units.literal: Although called peerlessly holy, her virtue renewed daily.

units.zh: 日新伊何，克廣弘仁。
units.en: What did renewal bring?
units.literal: What meant daily renewal?

units.zh: 終溫且惠，帝妹是親。
units.en: Ever-kind, ever-gentle—she cherished the emperor’s own sisters.
units.literal: She widened lavish kindness—she cherished the emperor’s sisters.

units.zh: 經緯六宮，罔不彌綸。
units.en: She threaded six wings of the harem—nothing slipped her weave.
units.literal: She wove order through six palaces—nothing escaped her net.

units.zh: 群妾惟仰，譬彼北辰。
units.en: Lesser ladies looked up as to the North Star.
units.literal: Concubines looked up as to the pole star.

units.zh: 亦既青陽，鳴鳩告時。
units.en: Spring greens when turtle-doves call the hour.
units.literal: Already green spring—the turtle dove announces season.

units.zh: 躬執桑曲，率導媵姬。
units.en: She led brides with mulberry hook in hand.
units.literal: She grasped mulberry hooks herself—leading attendant brides.

units.zh: 修成蠶蔟，分繭理絲。
units.en: She tended trays, split cocoons, sorted filament.
units.literal: She finished silkworm trays—partitioned cocoons, sorted silk.

units.zh: 女工是察，祭服是治。
units.en: She inspected needlework and fashioned sacral gowns.
units.literal: She inspected women’s work—she directed ritual robes.

units.zh: 祗奉宗廟，永言孝思。
units.en: She served the temple—always mindful of filial hearts.
units.literal: She reverently served the ancestral temple—ever speaking filial thought.

units.zh: 于彼六行，靡不蹈之。
units.en: She practiced every womanly virtue.
units.literal: Of those six conducts—she trod every one.

units.zh: 皇英佐舜，塗山翼禹。
units.en: Ehuang and Nüying aided Shun; Tushan aided Yu.
units.literal: Huang and Ying aided Shun; Tushan winged Yu.

units.zh: 惟衛惟樊，二霸是輔。
units.en: Wei Ji and Fan Ji steadied two hegemons.
units.literal: Only Wei, only Fan—two hegemons relied on them.

units.zh: 明明我后，異世同矩。
units.en: Bright our queen—another age, same measure.
units.literal: Bright bright our queen—different age, same square rule.

units.zh: 亦能有亂，謀及天府。
units.en: She too could heal unrest ; she schemed with Heaven’s storehouse.
units.literal: She too could cope with turmoil ; she planned with Heaven’s treasury.

units.zh: 內敷陰教，外毗陽化。
units.en: Within she spread yin teaching; without she aided yang rule.
units.literal: Within she spread women’s teaching; without she aided yang transformation.

units.zh: 綢繆庶正，密勿夙夜。
units.en: She knit every minister—tireless day and night.
units.literal: She bound together myriad officers—diligent night and day.

units.zh: 恩從風翔，澤隨雨播。
units.en: Her grace rode wind; her bounty fell like rain.
units.literal: Grace rode the wind; bounty fell like rain.

units.zh: 中外禔福，遐邇詠歌。
units.en: Court and countryside flourished; near and far sang hymns.
units.literal: Inner and outer gained bliss—near and far sang praise.

units.zh: 天祚貞吉，克昌克繁。
units.en: Heaven kept auspicious fate—family branches multiplied.
units.literal: Heaven’s mandate stayed auspicious—multiplying, branching wide.

units.zh: 則百斯慶，育聖育賢。
units.en: Blessings arrived in hundreds—bearing sage sons and worthy princes.
units.literal: Thus came hundredfold blessing—bearing sages and worthies.

units.zh: 教踰妊姒，訓邁姜嫄。
units.en: Her teaching topped Si and Ren; her norms surpassed Jiang Yuan.
units.literal: Teaching surpassed Ren and Si; instruction overtook Jiang Yuan.

units.zh: 堂堂太子，惟國之元。
units.en: Lofty the heir—pillar of the realm.
units.literal: Grand stands the crown prince—root of the state.

units.zh: 濟濟南陽，為屏為藩。
units.en: Splendid Nanyang princes—screens and river guards.
units.literal: Splendid princes of Nanyang—screens and hedges for the throne.

units.zh: 本支菴藹，四海蔭焉。
units.en: Root and branch spread shade—the realm rests cool.
units.literal: Root and branch shade thick—four seas rest beneath.

units.zh: 微斯皇妣，孰茲克臻。
units.en: Without this queen mother—who could climb so high?
units.literal: Without this royal mother—who could reach such zenith?

units.zh: 曰乾蓋聰，曰聖允誠。
units.en: They call Heaven keen; they call sageness true.
units.literal: They say Qian is keen; they say sage is true.

units.zh: 積善之堂，五福所并。
units.en: Goodness piled high—the five blessings gather.
units.literal: Hall piled with goodness—five blessings assemble.

units.zh: 宜享高年，匪隕匪傾。
units.en: She deserved long years—never to fall or fail.
units.literal: She should enjoy lofty years—not fall, not tilt.

units.zh: 如彭之齒，如聃之齡。
units.en: Like Peng Zu’s span; like Laozi’s age.
units.literal: Like Peng’s tooth-count; like Dan’s lifespan.

units.zh: 云胡不造，于茲禍殃[5]。
units.en: Why deny Heaven’s favor—why strike her here [5]?
units.literal: Why was fortune not granted—here calamity struck [5]?

units.zh: 寢疾彌留，寤寐不康。
units.en: She lingered at death’s door—no sleep brought ease.
units.literal: Illness lingered at death’s gate—sleep brought no peace.

units.zh: 巫咸騁術，和鵲奏方。
units.en: Shaman Xian worked spells; healers He and Que brewed drafts.
units.literal: Wu Xian wielded arts; He and Bian offered prescriptions.

units.zh: 祈禱無應，嘗藥無良。
units.en: Prayers failed; every draught proved vain.
units.literal: Prayers won no answer; tasted drugs brought no cure.

units.zh: 形神將離，載昏載荒。
units.en: Body and soul slipped apart—dimming into gloom.
units.literal: Body and spirit parted—darkening, wasting.

units.zh: 奄忽崩殂，湮精滅光。
units.en: Suddenly she fell—light drowned in dark.
units.literal: Suddenly she collapsed—spirit sank, light died.

units.zh: 哀哀太子，南陽繁昌。
units.en: The heir mourns—the flourishing prince of Nanyang.
units.literal: Mournful crown prince—Nanyang’s flowering prince.

units.zh: 攀援不寐，擗踊摧傷。
units.en: He cannot climb from grief—beats his breast till bones break.
units.literal: He climbs yet cannot sleep—beats breast and breast is torn.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas for this sorrow!
units.literal: Alas, oh grief!

units.zh: 闔宮號咷，宇內震驚。
units.en: Every hall keened—the realm inside the seas shook.
units.literal: Whole palace wailed—the realm within seas trembled.

units.zh: 奔者填衢，赴者塞庭。
units.en: Runners clogged roads—mourners packed the yard.
units.literal: Runners choked the avenues—mourners jammed the courtyard.

units.zh: 哀慟雷駭，流淚雨零。
units.en: Mourning crashed like thunder; tears fell like showers.
units.literal: Grief crashed like thunder—tears fell like rain.

units.zh: 歔欷不已，若喪所生。
units.en: No sob ends—as if a parent died.
units.literal: Sobs cease not—as if parents were lost.

units.zh: 惟帝與后，契闊在昔。
units.en: Emperor and queen—pledged long ago.
units.literal: Emperor and consort—long joined in ancient pledge.

units.zh: 比翼白屋，雙飛紫閣。
units.en: They nested in humble roofs—then flew paired to purple halls.
units.literal: Wing to wing from white-thatched halls—paired flight to purple towers.

units.zh: 悼后傷后，早即窀穸。
units.en: They mourn their queen—she sank too soon to stone.
units.literal: Mourning queen, wounded queen—early she entered the vault.

units.zh: 言斯既及，涕泗隕落。
units.en: Speech stops here—tears and mucus fall.
units.literal: Words reach here—tears and mucus fall.

units.zh: 追惟我后，實聰實哲。
units.en: Remembering her—truly keen, truly wise.
units.literal: Tracing my queen—truly keen, truly wise.

units.zh: 通于性命，達于儉節。
units.en: She grasped life’s truth—she mastered austerity.
units.literal: She penetrated nature and fate—she grasped thrift’s rule.

units.zh: 送終之禮，比素上世。
units.en: Her burial honored utmost thrift—plain as oldest times.
units.literal: Funeral rites matched plain antiquity—pared like highest ages.

units.zh: 襚無珍寶，唅無明月。
units.en: Her grave clothes bore no gems; no pearl filled her mouth.
units.literal: Burial garments held no treasure; mouth jewels held no bright moon-pearl.

units.zh: 潛輝梓宮，永背昭晰。
units.en: Her gleam sinks in the catalpa bier—gone from daylight forever.
units.literal: Hidden radiance in the catalpa palace—forever turned from clear light.

units.zh: 臣妾哀號，同此斷絕。
units.en: We servants keened—we shared that rupture.
units.literal: Concubines and maids wail—together cut off.

units.zh: 庭宇遏密，幽室增陰。
units.en: Courtyards fell mute; shadow thickened every room.
units.literal: Courtyard silence grows dense—dark chambers deepen shade.

units.zh: 空設幃帳，虛置衣衾。
units.en: Silken curtains hang hollow; quilts lie unused.
units.literal: Canopies stand empty—robes and quilts vainly spread.

units.zh: 人亦有言，神道難尋。
units.en: Men say ghost roads cannot be traced.
units.literal: Men also say the spirit path cannot be traced.

units.zh: 悠悠精爽，豈浮豈沈。
units.en: Her bright soul wanders—does it rise or sink?
units.literal: Far drifts her shining soul—does it float or sink?

units.zh: 豐奠日陳，冀魂之臨。
units.en: Opulent gifts pile daily—we pray her ghost approaches.
units.literal: Rich offerings daily spread—we hope the soul draws near.

units.zh: 孰云元后，不聞其音。
units.en: Who claims our primal queen hears nothing now?
units.literal: Who says the primal queen—cannot hear her voice?

units.zh: 乃議景行，景行已溢[6]。
units.en: They praised her conduct—it already overflowed measure [6].
units.literal: Thus they debated her lofty course—her course already overflowed [6].

units.zh: 乃考龜筮，龜筮襲吉。
units.en: Tortoise and yarrow both answered doubly auspicious.
units.literal: Thus they consulted tortoise and milfoil—both auguries doubled auspicious.

units.zh: 爰定宅兆，克成玄室。
units.en: They fixed the grave site—raised the hidden vault.
units.literal: Therefore they fixed tomb precinct—completed the dark chamber.

units.zh: 魂之往矣，于以令日。
units.en: Her soul sets forth—this chosen day.
units.literal: The soul journeys hence—on this appointed day.

units.zh: 仲秋之晨，啟明始出。
units.en: Autumn dawn—morning star climbs.
units.literal: Morning of mid-autumn—Venus first rises.

units.zh: 星陳夙駕，靈輿結駟。
units.en: Stars still blaze as horses hitch—the spirit coach spans four bays.
units.literal: Stars arrayed, harness at dawn—spirit carriage teams four bays.

units.zh: 其輿伊何？
units.en: What coach bore her?
units.literal: What was her carriage?

units.zh: 金根玉箱。
units.en: Gold-wheeled coach and jade-lined chest.
units.literal: Golden root and jade chest.

units.zh: 其駟伊何？
units.en: What bays drew her?
units.literal: What were her bays?

units.zh: 二駱雙黃。
units.en: White Luos paired with golden bays.
units.literal: Twin white foals and paired yellow steeds.

units.zh: 習習容車，朱服丹章。
units.en: Rustling draped bier—scarlet robes and vermillion stripes.
units.literal: Rustling draped coach—vermillion robes and cinnabar seal-pattern.

units.zh: 隱隱轜軒，弁絰繐裳。
units.en: Low rumbling hearses—mourning bands and hemp skirts.
units.literal: Dim hearse wagons—mourning caps and sackcloth skirts.

units.zh: 華轂曜野，素蓋被原。
units.en: Jeweled hubs flame across fields—white shades blanket the moor.
units.literal: Splendid hubs blaze the wilds—white canopies mantle the plain.

units.zh: 方相仡仡，旌旐翻翻。
units.en: Masked squaremen march—spirit banners whip and flutter.
units.literal: Exorcist-mask bearers stride—pennons and ghost-flags whirl.

units.zh: 輓童引歌，白驥鳴轅。
units.en: Children guide laments—white steeds keen at shafts.
units.literal: Dirge boys lead songs—white horses cry at traces.

units.zh: 觀者夾塗，士女涕漣。
units.en: Roadways jam with watchers—lords and ladies sob.
units.literal: Spectators crowd the road—gentlemen and ladies weep streams.

units.zh: 千乘萬騎，迄彼峻山。
units.en: Thousands of riders climb toward steep Jun ridge.
units.literal: Thousand carriages, myriad riders—reach those steep hills.

units.zh: 峻山峨峨，曾阜重阿。
units.en: Jun summit rises—ridge folds on ridge.
units.literal: Jun ridge towers—layered peaks fold ridge on ridge.

units.zh: 弘高顯敞，據洛背河。
units.en: Lofty and bright—it faces Luo with River behind.
units.literal: Vast height and open breadth—it fronts Luo with Yellow River at its back.

units.zh: 左瞻皇姑，右睇帝家。
units.en: Left toward royal mothers—right toward imperial tombs.
units.literal: Left gaze royal mother-in-law—right glance imperial kin.

units.zh: 推存揆亡，明神所嘉。
units.en: Judging life and death—the gods approve.
units.literal: Measuring life and death—bright spirits approve.

units.zh: 諸姑姊妹，娣姒媵御。
units.en: Aunts, sisters, co-wives, and maids—
units.literal: Aunts and sisters, wives and cousins, brides and attendants.

units.zh: 追送塵軌，號咷衢路。
units.en: they chased the dust—wailing choked every lane.
units.literal: They chased dust of wheel-tracks—wailing clogged roadways.

units.zh: 王侯卿士，雲會星布。
units.en: Lords and ministers clustered like clouds and stars.
units.literal: Princes and nobles—gathered like clouds, scattered like stars.

units.zh: 群官庶僚，縞蓋無數。
units.en: Official multitudes—countless white shades.
units.literal: Hosts of officers—white canopies beyond count.

units.zh: 咨嗟通夜，東方云曙。
units.en: They sighed till dawn broke east.
units.literal: Sighing through the night—east turns toward dawn.

units.zh: 百祇奉迎，我后安厝。
units.en: Spirits greet her—our queen is laid to rest.
units.literal: Hundred gods attend—our queen finds rest.

units.zh: 中外俱臨，同哀並慕。
units.en: Court and countryside mourn together.
units.literal: Inner and outer stand vigil—shared grief and longing.

units.zh: 涕如連雲，淚如湛露。
units.en: Tears hang like clouds—drops fall like dew.
units.literal: Tears like linked clouds—drops like heavy dew.

units.zh: 扃闓既闔，窈窈冥冥。
units.en: Stone gates sealed—depths sink black.
units.literal: Gate leaves shut tight—deep dark within.

units.zh: 有夜無晝，曷用其明。
units.en: Night without sun—what good is sight?
units.literal: Night without day—what use is light?

units.zh: 不封不樹，山阪同形。
units.en: No mound, no marker—she lies plain as the slope.
units.literal: No mound raised, no tree planted—hill slopes keep plain shape.

units.zh: 昔后之崩，大火西流。
units.en: When she died last year—the Fire star slid west.
units.literal: When former queen died—great Fire constellation sank west.

units.zh: 寒往暑過，今亦孟秋。
units.en: Cold yielded to heat—again first autumn comes.
units.literal: Cold went, heat passed—again we reach first autumn.

units.zh: 自我銜卹，儵忽一周。
units.en: Since grief seized me—a year flashed past.
units.literal: Since I bore grief—a blur one full cycle.

units.zh: 衣服將變，痛心若抽。
units.en: Mourning clothes turn—my vitals twist.
units.literal: Garments soon change—pain grips like twisting entrails.

units.zh: 逼彼禮制，惟以增憂。
units.en: Ritual presses harder—only sorrow swells.
units.literal: Forced by ritual codes—only grief increases.

units.zh: 去此素衣，結戀靈丘。
units.en: I shed white hemp yet cling to her burial mound.
units.literal: Leaving these plain robes—I cling to spirit hill.

units.zh: 有始有終，天地之經。
units.en: Beginnings and endings weave Heaven’s law.
units.literal: Having beginning and end—is Heaven and Earth’s warp.

units.zh: 自非三光，誰能不零。
units.en: Unless you are sun, moon, stars—who escapes falling?
units.literal: Unless you are three luminaries—who avoids decay?

units.zh: 存播令德，沒圖丹青。
units.en: Alive she spread virtue—dead artists paint her face.
units.literal: Living she spread fair virtue—dead her image paints silks.

units.zh: 先哲之志，以此為榮。
units.en: Ancient worthies deemed this their glory.
units.literal: Former sages held this—their glory.

units.zh: 溫溫元后，實宣慈焉。
units.en: Gentle primal queen—she truly spread kindness.
units.literal: Gentle primal queen—she truly spread kindness.

units.zh: 撫育群生，恩惠滋焉。
units.en: She nurtured every life—kindness overflowed.
units.literal: She nurtured all creatures—grace welled forth.

units.zh: 遺愛不已，永見思焉。
units.en: Her love lingers—memory never fades.
units.literal: Love left behind never ends—forever remembered.

units.zh: 懸名日月，垂萬春焉。
units.en: Her name rides moon and sun—through endless springs.
units.literal: Her name hangs with sun and moon—through myriad springs.

units.zh: 嗚呼庶妾，感四時焉。
units.en: Mean concubine feels—four seasons turn.
units.literal: Alas mean concubine—I feel the four seasons.

units.zh: 言思言慕，涕漣洏焉。
units.en: Each word of longing—tears trail.
units.literal: Speaking longing, speaking yearning—tears trail down.

units.zh: 咸寧二年，納悼后，芬于座受詔作頌，其辭曰：
units.en: In 276 they welcomed Empress Yang Zhi; Zuo Fen took orders at banquet to hymn her:
units.literal: In second Xianning they brought in Empress Dao; Fen at seat received edict to compose praise, saying:

units.zh: 峨峨華嶽，峻極泰清。
units.en: Towering Huashan—summit kisses sky.
units.literal: Towering Mount Hua—crest piercing pure heaven.

units.zh: 巨靈導流，河瀆是經。
units.en: River Lord splits torrents—the Great River keeps its channel.
units.literal: Giant Spirit cleaves currents—the Yellow River follows its course.

units.zh: 惟瀆之神，惟嶽之靈。
units.en: Spirit of ford and spirit of peak—
units.literal: Spirit of the river—spirit of the peak.

units.zh: 鍾于楊族，載育盛明。
units.en: —they fused in House Yang and bred this brilliance.
units.literal: They chimed on Yang clan—bearing this splendid brightness.

units.zh: 穆穆我后，應期挺生。
units.en: August queen—born to meet the hour.
units.literal: Solemn our queen—she answered fate and rose supreme.

units.zh: 含聰履喆，岐嶷夙成。
units.en: Clever from birth—child sage mature.
units.literal: She bore keen wit and trod wisdom—child prodigy early formed.

units.zh: 如蘭之茂，如玉之榮。
units.en: Orchid lush—jade radiant.
units.literal: Like orchid lush—like jade lustrous.

units.zh: 越在幼沖，休有令名。
units.en: Still in swaddling—already famed.
units.literal: Though still in cradle—she bore fair fame.

units.zh: 飛聲八極，翕習紫庭。
units.en: Her voice crossed eight zones—purple palace applauded.
units.literal: Her fame flew eight poles—she gathered praise in purple court.

units.zh: 超妊邈姒，比德皇英。
units.en: Past Ren and Si—she rivals Ehuang and Nüying.
units.literal: Beyond Ren and Si—her virtue pairs Huang and Ying.

units.zh: 京室是嘉，備禮致娉。
units.en: The court esteemed her—honored matchmakers sealed the pact.
units.literal: Capital praised her—full rites performed betrothal.

units.zh: 令月吉辰，百僚奉迎。
units.en: On chosen moon and day—every minister welcomed her.
units.literal: Bright month, lucky day—hundred officers welcomed her.

units.zh: 周生歸韓，詩人是詠。
units.en: When Zhou-sheng wed Han—the poets sang.
units.literal: Zhou-sheng returned to Han—the poets sing.

units.zh: 我后戾止，車服暉映。
units.en: Our queen arrived—coach lacquer flashed.
units.literal: Our queen arrived—carriages and robes gleamed.

units.zh: 登位太微，明德日盛。
units.en: She mounted throne—virtue brightened daily.
units.literal: She mounted Polar Throne—bright virtue daily waxed.

units.zh: 群黎欣戴，函夏同慶。
units.en: All lands rejoiced—the realm within seas sang.
units.literal: All folk rejoiced—all within seas shared joy.

units.zh: 翼翼聖皇，叡喆孔純。
units.en: Solemn sage emperor—pure in deepest wit.
units.literal: Solemn sage emperor—profound wisdom utterly pure.

units.zh: 愍茲狂戾，闡惠播仁。
units.en: He pitied cruel times—spread mercy everywhere.
units.literal: He pitied cruel turmoil—spread kindness and planted mercy.

units.zh: 蠲釁滌穢，與時惟新。
units.en: He washed sin away—made all things new.
units.literal: He wiped stains and washed filth—renewed with seasons.

units.zh: 沛然洪赦，恩詔遐震。
units.en: Grand amnesty rolled—edicts shook frontiers.
units.literal: Surging great amnesty—edicts shook distant shores.

units.zh: 后之踐阼，囹圄虛陳。
units.en: When she rose—jails gaped empty.
units.literal: When she mounted throne—prisons stood empty.

units.zh: 萬國齊歡，六合同欣。
units.en: Ten thousand states danced—six directions sang.
units.literal: Ten thousand lands rejoiced—six zones shared delight.

units.zh: 坤神抃舞，天人載悅。
units.en: Earth spirit dances—Heaven and mortals thrill.
units.literal: Earth goddess claps—Heaven and man rejoice.

units.zh: 興瑞降祥，表精日月。
units.en: Good omens arrive—sun and moon blaze essence.
units.literal: Omens rise—sun and moon display essence.

units.zh: 和氣煙熅，三光朗烈。
units.en: Warm vapors coil—three lights burn bright.
units.literal: Harmony veils warm mist—three luminaries blaze clear.

units.zh: 既獲嘉時，尋播甘雪。
units.en: Blessed hour brings timely snow.
units.literal: Season blessed—they soon spread sweet snow.

units.zh: 玄雲晻藹，靈液霏霏。
units.en: Purple clouds billow—spirit dew drifts.
units.literal: Dark clouds veil thick—numinous dew drifts fine.

units.zh: 既儲既積，待陽而晞。
units.en: Moisture gathers—sun must dry it.
units.literal: Stored and piled—it waits for sun to dry.

units.zh: 曣晛沾濡，柔潤中畿。
units.en: Warm vapor drenches—capital fields soften.
units.literal: Moisture soaks—soft rains central fields.

units.zh: 長享豐年，福祿永綏。
units.en: Enjoy fat harvests—wealth and peace endure.
units.literal: Long enjoy rich years—blessing and wage forever calm.

units.zh: 及帝女萬年公主薨，帝痛悼不已，詔芬為誄，其文甚麗。
units.en: When Princess Wannian died Wu mourned without cease and bid Zuo Fen write—her elegy was splendid.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu’s daughter Princess Wannian died, the emperor grieved endlessly and ordered Fen to compose a dirge—its prose extremely beautiful.

units.zh: 帝重芬詞藻，每有方物異寶，必詔為賦頌，以是屢獲恩賜焉。
units.en: He prized her lines; each tribute beast or gem won an ode—she gathered repeated gifts.
units.literal: The emperor prized Fen’s phrasing; whenever rare treasures arrived he ordered rhapsodies and hymns—thereby she repeatedly received imperial gifts.

units.zh: 答兄思詩、書及雜賦頌數十篇，並行于世。
units.en: Her replies to Zuo Si and dozens of essays circulated widely.
units.literal: Replies to brother Si’s poems, letters, and assorted rhapsodies and hymns—several tens of pieces—all circulated in the age.

units.zh: 胡貴嬪
units.en: Lady Hu of Honorable Rank
units.literal: Honorable Lady Hu

units.zh: 胡貴嬪名芳。
units.en: Lady Hu Fang bore that name.
units.literal: Honorable Lady Hu was named Fang.

units.zh: 父奮，別有傳。
units.en: Her father Hu Fen has his own biography.
units.literal: Her father Fen has a separate biography.

units.zh: 泰始九年，帝多簡良家子女以充內職，自擇其美者以絳紗繫臂。
units.en: In 273 he drafted palace girls from good families and marked his favorites with crimson silk arm-bands.
units.literal: In ninth Taishi year the emperor broadly drafted daughters of good houses for inner service and personally tied crimson gauze on those he deemed fairest.

units.zh: 而芳既入選，下殿號泣。
units.en: Hu Fang crossed the hall weeping once chosen.
units.literal: When Fang entered selection she descended the hall weeping and crying.

units.zh: 左右止之曰：「陛下聞聲。」
units.en: Attendants hissed, “The emperor will hear.”
units.literal: Attendants beside her stopped her: “His Majesty will hear your voice.”

units.zh: 芳曰：「死且不畏，何畏陛下！」
units.en: She shot back, “I do not fear even death—why should I fear Your Majesty?”
units.literal: Fang said: “I fear not death—why fear His Majesty!”

units.zh: 帝遣洛陽令司馬肇策拜芳為貴嬪。
units.en: Emperor Wu had Luoyang prefect Sima Zhao invest her with honorable rank.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Luoyang Magistrate Sima Zhao to invest Fang as honorable lady by tally.

units.zh: 帝每有顧問，不飾言辭，率爾而答，進退方雅。
units.en: Whenever he questioned her she answered straight without flourish—yet comported herself with modest grace.
units.literal: Whenever the emperor questioned her she did not polish phrases—answered plainly yet withdrew with modest grace.

units.zh: 時帝多內寵，平吳之後復納孫皓宮人數千，自此掖庭殆將萬人。
units.en: After Wu fell he absorbed thousands of Sun Hao’s girls until the harem neared ten thousand souls.
units.literal: At that time the emperor greatly favored inner chambers; after conquering Wu he took several thousand of Sun Hao’s palace women—thereafter pepper chambers neared ten thousand.

units.zh: 而並寵者甚眾，帝莫知所適，常乘羊車，恣其所之，至便宴寢。
units.en: So many favorites he rode a goat cart wherever chance led and slept there.
units.literal: Many equally favored—emperor knew not whom to choose—often rode goat-drawn cart wherever it pleased, feasting and bedding where it stopped.

units.zh: 宮人乃取竹葉插戶，以鹽汁灑地，而引帝車。
units.en: Women sprinkled salt and hung bamboo leaves to steer his goat cart.
units.literal: Palace ladies therefore inserted bamboo leaves in doors, sprinkled salt water on ground to lure emperor’s cart.

units.zh: 然芳最蒙愛幸，殆有專房之寵焉，侍御服飾亞于皇后。
units.en: Hu Fang won nearest monopoly favor—her wardrobe rivaled the empress.
units.literal: Yet Fang received deepest favor—almost exclusive chamber privilege—attendants’ robes secondary only to empress.

units.zh: 帝嘗與之摴蒱，爭矢，遂傷上指。
units.en: Playing dice for arrows she wounded his finger.
units.literal: Emperor once played chupu with her; quarreling over arrows they wounded his finger.

units.zh: 帝怒曰：「此固將種也！」
units.en: He snapped, “That’s pure warrior blood!”
units.literal: Emperor angrily said: “This truly is general stock!”

units.zh: 芳對曰：「北伐公孫，西距諸葛，非將種而何？」
units.en: She shot back, “Your house marched north against Gongsun and held off Zhuge in the west—what else is warlord stock?”
units.literal: Fang replied: “North your house attacked Gongsun—west it held off Zhuge—if not general stock, what?”

units.zh: 帝甚有慚色。
units.en: He flushed with shame.
units.literal: The emperor felt deeply ashamed.

units.zh: 芳生武安公主。
units.en: She bore Princess Wu’an.
units.literal: Fang bore Princess Wu’an.

units.zh: 諸葛夫人
units.en: Lady Zhuge
units.literal: Lady Zhuge

units.zh: 諸葛夫人名婉，琅邪陽都人也。
units.en: Lady Zhuge Wan came from Yangdu in Langya.
units.literal: Lady Zhuge was named Wan, a native of Yangdu in Langya.

units.zh: 父沖，字茂長，廷尉卿。
units.en: Her father Zhuge Chong, courtesy Maochang, served as Commandant of Justice.
units.literal: Her father Chong, courtesy Maochang, was Commandant of Justice.

units.zh: 婉以泰始九年春入宮，帝臨軒，使使持節、洛陽令司馬肇拜為夫人。
units.en: In spring 273 she entered court; Emperor Wu had Sima Zhao invest her as Lady from the southern gallery.
units.literal: In spring of ninth Taishi year she entered palace; emperor faced southern porch and ordered envoy with tally Luoyang Magistrate Sima Zhao to invest her as lady.

units.zh: 兄銓，字德林，散騎常侍。
units.en: Her brother Zhuge Quan, courtesy Delin, was a palace attendant.
units.literal: Elder brother Quan, courtesy Delin, was Palace Rider Regular Attendant.

units.zh: 銓弟玫，字仁林，侍中、御史中丞。
units.en: Quan’s younger brother Zhuge Mei, courtesy Renlin, was Palace Attendant and Palace Assistant Imperial Clerk.
units.literal: Quan’s younger brother Mei, courtesy Renlin, was Palace Attendant and Palace Assistant Imperial Clerk.

units.zh: 玫婦弟周穆，清河王覃之舅也。
units.en: Mei’s brother-in-law Zhou Mu was uncle to Prince Tan of Qinghe.
units.literal: Mei’s brother-in-law Zhou Mu was maternal uncle of Prince Qinghe of Qinghe.

units.zh: 永嘉初，穆與玫勸東海王越廢懷帝，立覃，越不許。
units.en: In early Yongjia Zhou Mu and Zhuge Mei urged Sima Yue to replace Huai with Tan—Yue refused.
units.literal: Early Yongjia, Mu with Mei urged Prince Donghai Yue to depose Emperor Huai and enthrone Tan—Yue refused.

units.zh: 重言之，越怒，遂斬玫及穆。
units.en: When pressed again Yue beheaded both.
units.literal: Urged again, Yue grew angry and executed Mei and Mu.

units.zh: 臨刑，玫謂穆曰：「我語卿何道？」
units.en: Mei asked Zhou Mu, “Did I not warn you?”
units.literal: Facing execution Mei said to Mu: “What did I tell you?”

units.zh: 穆曰：「今日復何所說。」
units.en: Mu answered, “Nothing left to say.”
units.literal: Mu said: “What more is there to say today?”

units.zh: 時人方知謀出於穆，非玫之意。
units.en: Only then did folk realize Zhou Mu schemed it—not Mei.
units.literal: People then learned the plot came from Mu—not Mei’s intent.

units.zh: 惠賈皇后
units.en: Empress Jia of Emperor Hui
units.literal: Empress Jia of Emperor Hui

units.zh: 惠賈皇后諱南風，平陽人也，小名時。
units.en: Empress Jia Nanfeng of Pingyang—pet name Shi.
units.literal: Empress Jia of Hui, taboo Nanfeng, native of Pingyang, childhood name Shi.

units.zh: 父充，別有傳。
units.en: Her father Jia Chong has his own biography.
units.literal: Her father Chong has separate biography.

units.zh: 初，武帝欲為太子取衛瓘女，元后納賈郭親黨之說，欲婚賈氏。
units.en: Wu favored Wei Guan’s daughter; Empress Yang Yan pushed Jia kin.
units.literal: At first Emperor Wu wished crown prince to marry Wei Guan’s daughter; Empress Yuan listened to Jia and Guo faction urging marriage with Jia clan.

units.zh: 帝曰：「衛公女有五可，賈公女有五不可。
units.en: Wu said, “Wei’s girl scores five merits—Jia’s five flaws.
units.literal: Emperor said: “Lord Wei’s daughter has five goods—Lord Jia’s daughter five bads.

units.zh: 衛家種賢而多子，美而長白；
units.en: Weis are fertile and wise—fair and statuesque;
units.literal: Wei house breeds wise and many sons—beautiful, tall, fair;

units.zh: 賈家種妒而少子，醜而短黑。」
units.en: Jias are jealous and barren—dark and squat."
units.literal: Jia house breeds jealousy and few sons—ugly, short, dark.”

units.zh: 元后固請，荀顗、荀勖並稱充女之賢，乃定婚。
units.en: Yang Yan insisted; Xun Yi and Xun Xu praised Jia’s girl—the match closed.
units.literal: Empress Yuan pressed firmly—Xun Yi and Xun Xu together praised Chong’s daughter’s virtue—betrothal fixed.

units.zh: 始欲聘后妹午，午年十二，小太子一歲，短小未勝衣。
units.en: They first chose sister Wu—twelve, petite beside the heir.
units.literal: At first they wished to engage younger sister Wu—Wu twelve years old, one year younger than crown prince, too short for robes.

units.zh: 更娶南風，時年十五，大太子二歲。
units.en: They wed Nanfeng instead—fifteen, two years his senior.
units.literal: They switched to Nanfeng—then fifteen, two years elder than crown prince.

units.zh: 泰始八年二月辛卯[7]，冊拜太子妃。
units.en: On the xinmao day of the second month of 272 she became crown princess [7].
units.literal: Eighth Taishi year second month xinmao [7]—invested crown princess.

units.zh: 妒忌多權詐，太子畏而惑之，嬪御罕有進幸者。
units.en: Jealous and scheming, she cowed the befuddled prince—other women seldom touched him.
units.literal: Jealous, crafty in intrigue—crown prince feared yet dazed—concubines rarely gained favor.

units.zh: 帝常疑太子不慧，且朝臣和嶠等多以為言，故欲試之。
units.en: Wu doubted the heir’s wit—He Qiao agreed—so he tested him.
units.literal: Emperor often suspected crown prince dull—and ministers such as He Qiao said same—so wished to test him.

units.zh: 盡召東宮大小官屬，為設宴會，而密封疑事，使太子決之，停信待反。
units.en: He feasted Eastern Palace staff, sealed riddling cases for the heir to solve.
units.literal: He summoned all eastern palace officials large and small, set banquet, sealed doubtful affairs ordering crown prince to decide—stopped courier awaiting reply.

units.zh: 妃大懼，倩外人作答。
units.en: Princess Jia panicked and outsourced answers.
units.literal: Consort greatly frightened—begged outsider compose answers.

units.zh: 答者多引古義。
units.en: Ghostwriters packed classics.
units.literal: Answerers mostly cited classical meanings.

units.zh: 給使張泓曰：「太子不學。
units.en: Clerk Zhang Hong warned, “He never studied.
units.literal: Orderly Zhang Hong said: “Crown prince does not study.

units.zh: 而答詔引義，必責作草主，更益譴負。
units.en: Classic prose exposes the ghostwriter.
units.literal: Yet reply edict cites meanings—surely will blame draft master—increasing blame.

units.zh: 不如直以意對。」
units.en: Plain speech fits better."
units.literal: Better answer straight from plain intent.”

units.zh: 妃大喜，語泓：「便為我好答，富貴與汝共之。」
units.en: She thrilled: "Write plainly for me—wealth and honor we will share."
units.literal: Consort rejoiced, telling Hong: "Answer well for me—wealth and honor shared with you."

units.zh: 泓素有小才，具草，令太子自寫。
units.en: Hong drafted; she made the prince copy.
units.literal: Hong always had small talent—drafted fully—ordered crown prince himself copy.

units.zh: 帝省之，甚悅。
units.en: Wu read it—delighted.
units.literal: Emperor examined—greatly pleased.

units.zh: 先示太子少傅衛瓘，瓘大踧踖，眾人乃知瓘先有毀言，殿上皆稱萬歲。
units.en: He flashed it at Wei Guan—Wei squirmed; courtiers jeered Guan’s prior slanders.
units.literal: First showed Junior Mentor Wei Guan—Guan greatly ashamed—all knew Guan earlier had slanderous words—hall cheered ten thousand years.

units.zh: 充密遣語妃云：「衛瓘老奴，幾破汝家。」
units.en: Jia Chong whispered to the consort, "Old slave Wei Guan nearly ruined your house."
units.literal: Chong secretly sent word to consort: "Old slave Wei Guan nearly ruined your house."

units.zh: 妃性酷虐，嘗手殺數人。
units.en: She killed with her own hands.
units.literal: Consort nature cruel—often personally killed several persons.

units.zh: 或以戟擲孕妾，子隨刃墮地。
units.en: She hurled a ji at a pregnant girl—the infant fell with the blow.
units.literal: Sometimes threw halberd at pregnant concubine—child fell with blade to ground.

units.zh: 帝聞之，大怒，已修金墉城，將廢之。
units.en: Wu rebuilt Jinyong cage ready to depose her.
units.literal: Emperor hearing greatly furious—already repaired Metal-Walled Fortress—about to depose her.

units.zh: 充華趙粲從容言曰：「賈妃年少，妒是婦人之情耳，長自當差。
units.en: Zhao Can soothed him: “She’s young—jealousy passes.
units.literal: Honorable Lady Zhao Can calmly said: “Consort Jia still young—jealousy is woman’s feeling—long maturity will correct.

units.zh: 願陛下察之。」
units.en: May Your Majesty weigh this carefully."
units.literal: May Your Majesty investigate.”

units.zh: 其後楊珧亦為之言曰：「陛下忘賈公閭耶？」
units.en: Yang Zhao added, “Remember Jia Chong?”
units.literal: Later Yang Zhao also spoke for her: “Your Majesty forgot Lord Jia Chong?”

units.zh: 荀勖深救之，故得不廢。
units.en: Xun Xu pleaded—she kept rank.
units.literal: Xun Xu deeply rescued her—thus avoided deposition.

units.zh: 惠帝即位，立為皇后，生河東、臨海、始平公主、哀獻皇女。
units.en: Hui made her queen—mother of Hedong, Linhai, Shiping princesses and others.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui ascended—established empress—bore Hedong, Linhai, Shiping princesses and mournful imperial daughter.

units.zh: 后暴戾日甚。
units.en: Her cruelty mounted daily.
units.literal: Consort violent cruelty daily worsened.

units.zh: 侍中賈模，后之族兄，右衛郭彰，后之從舅，並以才望居位，與楚王瑋、東安公繇分掌朝政。
units.en: Jia Mo and Guo Zhang ran court beside Sima Wei and Sima Yao.
units.literal: Palace Attendant Jia Mo—consort’s lineage elder; Guards-general Guo Zhang—consort’s maternal uncle—both by talent and prestige held posts sharing governance with Prince Chu Wei and Duke Dongan Yao.

units.zh: 后母廣城君養孫賈謐干預國事，權侔人主。
units.en: Lady Guo raised Jia Mi—his power rivaled the throne.
units.literal: Consort mother Lady Guangcheng raised grandson Jia Mi meddling state affairs—authority matched sovereign.

units.zh: 繇密欲廢后，賈氏憚之。
units.en: Sima Yao plotted deposition—Jias feared him.
units.literal: Yao secretly wished depose consort—Jia faction feared him.

units.zh: 及太宰亮、衛瓘等表繇徙帶方，奪楚王中候，后知瑋怨之，乃使帝作密詔令瑋誅瓘、亮，以報宿憾。
units.en: When Sima Liang and Wei Guan banished Yao and clipped Wei’s guard—she forged orders for Sima Wei to murder Liang and Wei.
units.literal: When Grand Mentor Liang and Wei Guan memorialized to exile Yao to Daifang and strip Prince Chu of central army inspector—consort knew Wei bore grudge—had emperor forge secret edict ordering Wei to kill Guan and Liang—settling old hatred.

units.zh: 模知后凶暴，恐禍及己，乃與裴頠、王衍謀廢之，衍悔而謀寢。
units.en: Jia Mo saw danger—plotted with Pei Wei and Wang Yan to depose her—Wang Yan backed out.
units.literal: Mo knew the consort was fierce—feared disaster reaching himself—and with Pei Wei and Wang Yan plotted her deposition—Yan repented—the plot slept.

units.zh: 后遂荒淫放恣，與太醫令程據等亂彰內外。
units.en: She ran riot with physician Cheng Ju.
units.literal: Consort then wanton and dissolute—with Imperial Physician Cheng Ju and others licentious noise inner and outer.

units.zh: 洛南有盜尉部小吏，端麗美容止，既給冢役，忽有非常衣服，眾咸疑其竊盜，尉嫌而辯之。
units.en: A pretty clerk toiling tombs wore silk—suspected theft.
units.literal: South of Luo petty clerk of thief corps—handsome bearing—assigned tomb labor yet wore extraordinary clothes—all suspected theft—captain interrogated.

units.zh: 賈后疏親欲求盜物，往聽對辭。
units.en: Jia kin listened to his confession.
units.literal: Consort distant kin sought stolen goods—went to hear interrogation.

units.zh: 小吏云：「先行逢一老嫗，說家有疾病，師卜云宜得城南少年厭之，欲暫相煩，必有重報。
units.en: The clerk said, "Going ahead I met an old woman who said her household was ill; diviners said a youth from south of the city should suppress it, and she wished briefly to trouble me, promising rich reward.
units.literal: Petty clerk said: “Going ahead met old woman saying household illness—diviners said need youth south of wall to suppress—wished borrow briefly—promised rich reward.

units.zh: 於是隨去，上車下帷，內簏箱中，行可十餘里，過六七門限，開簏箱，忽見樓闕好屋。
units.en: She rode blindfolded through gates till palaces appeared.
units.literal: Therefore followed—entered carriage hung curtains—inside bamboo chest—traveled ten-plus li—passed six-seven gates—opened chest—suddenly saw storied towers fine halls.

units.zh: 問此是何處，云是天上，即以香湯見浴，好衣美食將入。
units.en: They called it Heaven—bathed and fed him.
units.literal: Asked where—said Heaven—thereupon fragrant broth bathed—fine clothes fine food led inside.

units.zh: 見一婦人，年可三十五六，短形青黑色，眉後有疵。
units.en: A squat dark woman in her mid-thirties bore a brow mole.
units.literal: Saw one woman—age about thirty-five or six—short form blue-black—scar behind eyebrow.

units.zh: 見留數夕，共寢歡宴，臨出贈此眾物。」
units.en: She kept me several nights—we feasted and slept together—and as I left she gave me all these goods."
units.literal: Detained several nights—slept together feasting—departing gifted many goods.”

units.zh: 聽者聞其形狀，知是賈后，慚笑而去，尉亦解意。
units.en: Listeners recognized Jia Nanfeng—the captain dropped charges.
units.literal: Hearers hearing shape knew it was Empress Jia—left ashamed laughing—captain understood.

units.zh: 時他人入者多死，惟此小吏，以后愛之，得全而出。
units.en: Others died visiting her bed—only her pet survived.
units.literal: Others entering mostly died—only this petty clerk—because consort loved him—escaped whole.

units.zh: 及河東公主有疾，師巫以為宜施寬令，乃稱詔大赦天下。
units.en: When her daughter sickened shamans demanded amnesty—she forged pardon.
units.literal: When Hedong princess fell ill—shamans said broad edicts needed—thereupon forged edict grand amnesty realm.

units.zh: 初，后詐有身，內稿物為產具，遂取妹夫韓壽子慰祖養之，託諒闇所生，故弗顯。
units.en: At first, the empress feigned pregnancy and brought in straw materials as childbirth supplies. She then took in and raised Weizu, the son of her sister's husband Han Shou, claiming he had been born during the mourning period and therefore keeping him out of public view.
units.literal: At first consort feigned pregnancy—packed straw goods as birthing gear—then took sister’s husband Han Shou’s son Weizu raising—claimed mourning-hall birth—therefore not openly shown.

units.zh: 遂謀廢太子，以所養代立。
units.en: She meant to replace the heir with him.
units.literal: Then plotted depose crown prince—establish fosterling.

units.zh: 時洛中謠曰：「南風烈烈吹黃沙，遙望魯國鬱嵯峨，前至三月滅汝家。」
units.en: Luoyang sang: "Nanfeng blasts yellow dust—far off Lu towers loom—by the third moon your house will fall."
units.literal: Then Luoyang rhyme said: "South wind fierce blows yellow sand—far gaze Lu kingdom towering—before third month ends your house."

units.zh: 后母廣城君以后無子，甚敬重愍懷，每勸厲后，使加慈愛。
units.en: Lady Guo prized Minhuai—begged Jia to cherish him.
units.literal: Consort mother Lady Guangcheng because consort lacked sons greatly revered Crown Prince Minhuai—often urged consort—made her add kindness.

units.zh: 賈謐恃貴驕縱，不能推崇太子，廣城君恒切責之。
units.en: Jia Mi insulted the heir—Lady Guo scolded him.
units.literal: Jia Mi relied on pride—could not honor crown prince—Lady Guangcheng constantly scolded.

units.zh: 及廣城君病篤，占術謂不宜封廣城，乃改封宜城。
units.en: Ill diviners forbade “Guangcheng”—her fief was changed to Yicheng.
units.literal: When Lady Guangcheng gravely ill—divination said unsuitable enfeoff Guangcheng—thereupon changed enfeoff Yicheng.

units.zh: 后出侍疾十餘日，太子常往宜城第，將醫出入，恂恂盡禮。
units.en: The empress spent more than ten days away tending her sick mother. The crown prince often visited the Yicheng residence with physicians, behaving respectfully and observing every courtesy.
units.literal: The empress went out to tend her mother during her illness for more than ten days. The crown prince often visited the Yicheng residence, bringing physicians in and out and respectfully observing every propriety.

units.zh: 宜城臨終執后手，令盡意于太子，言甚切至。
units.en: She clasped Jia’s hand—beg her shield Minhuai.
units.literal: Yicheng dying grasped consort’s hand—ordered exhaust feeling toward crown prince—speech extremely earnest.

units.zh: 又曰：「趙粲及午必亂汝事，我死後，勿復聽入，深憶吾言。」
units.en: She also said, "Zhao Can and Jia Wu will surely disrupt your affairs; after I die, do not admit them again—remember my words well."
units.literal: Also said: “Zhao Can and Wu surely ruin your affairs—after I die—never hear them again—deeply remember my words.”

units.zh: 后不能遵之，遂專制天下，威服內外。
units.en: Jia ignored—ruled alone.
units.literal: Consort could not obey—thereupon monopolized realm—awe subdued inner and outer.

units.zh: 更與粲、午專為姦謀，誣害太子，眾惡彰著。
units.en: She schemed with them against Minhuai.
units.literal: Further with Can, Wu solely plotted wickedness—slandered harmed crown prince—crowds of evils manifest.

units.zh: 初，誅楊駿及汝南王亮、太保衛瓘、楚王瑋等，皆臨機專斷，宦人董猛參預其事。
units.en: Yang Jun, Sima Liang, Wei Guan, Sima Wei died by her whim—with eunuch Dong Meng.
units.literal: At first executing Yang Jun and Prince Runan Liang, Grand Tutor Wei Guan, Prince Chu Wei—all improvised executions—eunuch Dong Meng participated.

units.zh: 猛，武帝時為寺人監，侍東宮，得親信于后，預誅楊駿，封武安侯，猛三兄皆為亭侯，天下咸怨。
units.en: Dong Meng gained titles—his brothers too—the realm cursed them.
units.literal: Meng—Wu-era Inner Palace Overseer—served Eastern Palace—won consort trust—participated executing Yang Jun—enfeoffed Marquis Wu’an—Meng three elder brothers all village marquis—all realm resented.

units.zh: 及太子廢黜，趙王倫、孫秀等因眾怨謀欲廢后[8]。
units.en: Once Minhuai fell Sima Lun and Sun Xiu used hatred to target her [8].
units.literal: When crown prince deposed—Prince Zhao Lun and Sun Xiu exploiting resentment plotted depose consort [8].

units.zh: 后數遣宮婢微服於人間視聽，其謀頗泄。
units.en: She spied on rumors—some leaked.
units.literal: Consort repeatedly sent palace maids plain clothes among folk spy listen—plot leaked somewhat.

units.zh: 后甚懼，遂害太子，以絕眾望。
units.en: Terrified she murdered Minhuai.
units.literal: Consort greatly afraid—thereupon harmed crown prince—cutting off hopes.

units.zh: 趙王倫乃率兵入宮，使翊軍校尉齊王冏入殿廢后。
units.en: Sima Lun stormed in—sent Sima Jiong to drag her out.
units.literal: Prince Zhao Lun then led troops palace—ordered Colonel Qi Wang Jiong enter hall depose consort.

units.zh: 后與冏母有隙，故倫使之。
units.en: The empress had fallen out with Jiong's mother, which was why Lun sent him.
units.literal: The empress had a quarrel with Jiong's mother, so Lun sent him.

units.zh: 后驚曰：「卿何為來！」
units.en: She cried, “Why you!”
units.literal: Consort alarmed said: “Why have you come!”

units.zh: 冏曰：「有詔收后。」
units.en: Jiong said, "There is an edict to seize you."
units.literal: Jiong said: "There is an edict to seize you."

units.zh: 后曰：「詔當從我出，何詔也？」
units.en: She snapped, "Edicts issue from me—what edict is this?"
units.literal: Consort said: "Edicts issue from me—what edict is this?"

units.zh: 后至上閤，遙呼帝曰：「陛下有婦，使人廢之，亦行自廢。」
units.en: Reaching the upper chamber she cried to the emperor, "Your Majesty has a wife, yet you let others depose her—you will be deposed yourself."
units.literal: Consort reaching upper chamber cried distant emperor: “Your Majesty has wife yet lets others depose her—you yourself will be deposed.”

units.zh: 又問冏曰：「起事者誰？」
units.en: She asked Jiong again, "Who raised this affair?"
units.literal: Again asked Jiong: “Who raised revolt?”

units.zh: 冏曰：「梁、趙。」
units.en: “Liang and Zhao.”
units.literal: Jiong said: “Liang and Zhao.”

units.zh: 后曰：「繫狗當繫頸，今反繫其尾，何得不然！」
units.en: “Chain a dog by the throat—you seized the tail—no wonder!”
units.literal: Consort said: “Leash dog by throat—now leash tail—how can it not be so!”

units.zh: 至宮西，見謐尸，再舉聲而哭遽止。
units.en: Seeing Jia Mi’s corpse she wailed twice—then silence.
units.literal: Reaching palace west saw Mi corpse—raised voice twice weeping suddenly stopped.

units.zh: 倫乃矯詔遣尚書劉弘等持節齎金屑酒賜后死。
units.en: Lun then forged an edict and sent Minister Liu Hong and others, bearing an imperial tally, to deliver wine mixed with gold filings and order the empress's death.
units.literal: Lun then forged edict dispatch Minister Liu Hong bearing tally deliver gold-filings wine grant consort death.

units.zh: 后在位十一年。
units.en: Eleven years queen.
units.literal: Consort held rank eleven years.

units.zh: 趙粲、賈午、韓壽、董猛等皆伏誅。
units.en: Zhao Can, Jia Wu, Han Shou, Dong Meng and the others were all executed.
units.literal: Zhao Can, Jia Wu, Han Shou, Dong Meng and the others were all executed.

units.zh: 臨海公主先封清河，洛陽之亂，為人所略，傳賣吳興錢溫。
units.en: Princess Qinghe—later Linhai—was kidnapped in chaos and sold to Qian Wen.
units.literal: Linhai princess first enfeoffed Qinghe—Luoyang turmoil—seized by men—sold onward to Qian Wen of Wuxing.

units.zh: 溫以送女，女遇主甚酷。
units.en: Qian Wen delivered her as a bride—the girl met a vicious mistress.
units.literal: Wen gave her as bride—daughter met mistress extremely cruel.

units.zh: 元帝鎮建鄴，主詣縣自言。
units.en: Once Yuan of Jin ruled Jianye she appealed at the yamen.
units.literal: When Yuan-di governed Jianye—princess went to county explaining herself.

units.zh: 元帝誅溫及女，改封臨海，宗正曹統尚之。
units.en: He executed Wen and his daughter, restored her Linhai title, and married her to Cao Tong.
units.literal: Yuan-di executed Wen and daughter—changed enfeoffment Linhai—Director of Imperial Clan Cao Tong married her.

units.zh: 惠羊皇后
units.en: Empress Yang of Emperor Hui
units.literal: Empress Yang of Emperor Hui

units.zh: 惠羊皇后諱獻容，泰山南城人。
units.en: Empress Yang Xianrong came from Nancheng in Taishan.
units.literal: Empress Yang of Hui, taboo Xianrong, native of Nancheng in Taishan.

units.zh: 祖瑾，父玄之，並見外戚傳。
units.en: Her grandfather Yang Jin and father Yang Xuanzhi appear among outer kin.
units.literal: Grandfather Jin; father Xuanzhi—both treated in Outer Kin treatise.

units.zh: 賈后既廢，孫秀議立后。
units.en: After Jia Nanfeng fell Sun Xiu debated a new queen.
units.literal: After Empress Jia deposed—Sun Xiu debated establishing empress.

units.zh: 后外祖孫旂與秀合族，又諸子自結於秀，故以太安元年立為皇后[9]。
units.en: Sun Qi’s tie to Sun Xiu won her the throne in 302 [9].
units.literal: Consort maternal grandfather Sun Qi shared clan with Xiu—sons bonded with Xiu—therefore first Taian year established empress [9].

units.zh: 將入宮，衣中有火。
units.en: Fire sparked inside her robes on palace entry.
units.literal: About to enter palace—fire appeared within robes.

units.zh: 成都王穎伐長沙王乂，以討玄之為名。
units.en: Sima Ying struck Sima Yi citing Yang Xuanzhi.
units.literal: Prince Chengdu Ying attacked Prince Changsha Yi—using punishing Xuanzhi as pretext.

units.zh: 乂敗，穎奏廢后為庶人，處金墉城。
units.en: After Yi fell Ying reduced her to commoner at Jinyong.
units.literal: Yi defeated—Ying memorialized deposing consort as commoner—housed Metal-Walled Fortress.

units.zh: 陳眕等唱伐成都王，大赦，復后位。
units.en: Chen Zhen’s coalition restored her with amnesty.
units.literal: Chen Zhen and others urged attacking Chengdu prince—grand amnesty—restored consort rank.

units.zh: 張方入洛，又廢后。
units.en: Zhang Fang returned and struck her title.
units.literal: Zhang Fang entered Luoyang—again deposed consort.

units.zh: 方逼遷大駕幸長安，留臺復后位。
units.en: Zhang Fang dragged the court west—Luoyang ministers restored her.
units.literal: Fang forced moving great carriage to Chang’an—Luoyang remnant court restored consort.

units.zh: 永興初，張方又廢后。
units.en: Early Yongxing Zhang Fang deposed her again.
units.literal: Early Yongxing—Zhang Fang again deposed consort.

units.zh: 河間王顒矯詔，以后屢為姦人所立，遣尚書田淑敕留臺賜后死。
units.en: Sima Yong forged orders—blaming meddlers—sent Tian Shu to kill her.
units.literal: Prince Hejian Yong forged edict—because consort repeatedly installed by villains—dispatched Minister Tian Shu ordering remnant court grant consort death.

units.zh: 詔書累至，司隸校尉劉暾與尚書僕射荀藩、河南尹周馥馳上奏曰：「奉被手詔，伏讀惶悴。
units.en: Liu Tun, Xun Fan, and Zhou Fu raced a plea: “Your sealed orders leave us shaking.
units.literal: Edicts piled—Metropolitan Commandant Liu Tun with Minister Director Xun Fan and Henan Intendant Zhou Fu galloped memorial saying: “Receiving handwritten edict—reading we tremble.

units.zh: 臣按古今書籍，亡國破家，毀喪宗祊，皆由犯眾違人之所致也。
units.en: History shows ruin follows when rulers betray the people.
units.literal: Your servants examine ancient and modern writings—states ruined, houses destroyed, ancestral temples smashed—all arise from offending masses and violating men.

units.zh: 陛下遷幸，舊京廓然，眾庶悠悠，罔所依倚。
units.en: You moved west—Luoyang lies bare—the people wander homeless.
units.literal: Your Majesty moved west—old capital empty—multitudes drift—nothing to lean on.

units.zh: 家有跂踵之心，人想鑾輿之聲，思望大德，釋兵歸農。
units.en: Every hearth cranes for your bells—the realm wants peace and fields.
units.literal: Households feel standing-on-tiptoe hearts—people imagine carriage bells—longing for great virtue—lay down arms return farming.

units.zh: 而兵纏不解，處處互起，豈非善者不至，人情猜隔故耶！
units.en: War still spreads because trust never came.
units.literal: Yet armies tangle unresolved—everywhere mutual rising—is it not because goodness has not arrived—human hearts suspiciously blocked?

units.zh: 今上官巳犯闕稱兵，焚燒宮省，百姓諠駭，宜鎮之以靜。
units.en: Shangguan Si burns the palace—calm needs quiet rule.
units.literal: Now Shangguan Si violates palace raising troops—burning palace offices—common folk clamor—should calm with stillness.

units.zh: 而大使卒至，赫然執藥，當詣金墉，內外震動，謂非聖意。
units.en: Suddenly envoys bear poison for Jinyong—none believe it is your wish.
units.literal: Yet great envoy suddenly arrives—awefully clutching poison—about to reach Metal-Walled Fortress—inner and outer shaken—say this cannot be sagely intent.

units.zh: 羊庶人門戶殘破，廢放空宮，門禁峻密，若絕天地，無緣得與姦人搆亂。
units.en: Yang wallows locked away—no traitor access.
units.literal: Lady Yang commoner gate shattered—cast aside empty palace—gate guards stern dense—as if heaven severed earth—no chance conspire with villains.

units.zh: 眾無智愚，皆謂不然，刑書猥至，罪不值辜，人心一憤，易致興動。
units.en: No one thinks her guilty—rash execution invites riot.
units.literal: Crowds wise or foolish—none deem it right—punishment writs pile—crime does not match guilt—one surge of rage—easily stirs revolt.

units.zh: 夫殺一人而天下喜悅者，宗廟社稷之福也。
units.en: Execute one villain and the realm cheers—that aids the shrines.
units.literal: To kill one yet realm rejoices—is fortune of ancestral temple altars.

units.zh: 今殺一枯窮之人而令天下傷慘，臣懼凶豎乘間，妄生變故。
units.en: Kill a helpless widow and horrify the realm—rebels will exploit it.
units.literal: Now kill one withered poor person yet order realm mourn—your servant fears vicious youths seize gap—recklessly breed change.

units.zh: 臣忝司京輦，觀察眾心，實以深憂，宜當含忍。
units.en: We guard the capital—we plead restraint.
units.literal: Your servant humbly supervises capital region—observing crowds’ hearts—truly deeply anxious—should tolerate endure.

units.zh: 不勝所見，謹密啟聞。
units.en: We cannot stay silent.
units.literal: Unable bear what seen—respectfully secret memorial heard.

units.zh: 願陛下更深與太宰參詳，勿令遠近疑惑，取謗天下。」
units.en: May Your Majesty consult further with the Grand Steward in depth; do not let near and far grow doubtful and draw reproach from all under Heaven."
units.literal: Wish Your Majesty deeper consult the Grand Steward—do not let far near doubt—invite slander realm-wide.”

units.zh: 顒見表大怒，乃遣陳顏、呂朗東收暾。
units.en: Yong raged—sent Chen Yan and Lu Lang to arrest Liu Tun.
units.literal: Yong seeing memorial furious—thereupon dispatched Chen Yan and Lu Lang east seize Tun.

units.zh: 暾奔青州，后遂得免。
units.en: Tun fled to Qingzhou—she survived.
units.literal: Tun fled Qingzhou—consort thereby escaped.

units.zh: 帝還洛，迎后復位。
units.en: When the emperor returned he restored her.
units.literal: Emperor returned Luoyang—welcomed consort restored rank.

units.zh: 後洛陽令何喬又廢后。
units.en: Magistrate He Qiao struck her title again.
units.literal: Later Luoyang Magistrate He Qiao again deposed consort.

units.zh: 及張方首至，其日復后位。
units.en: Zhang Fang’s head reached Luoyang—she rose again that day.
units.literal: When Zhang Fang’s head arrived—that day restored consort rank.

units.zh: 會帝崩，后慮太弟立為嫂叔，不得稱太后，催前太子清河王覃入，將立之，不果。
units.en: At Hui’s death she feared Sima Chi would make her sister-in-law—she rushed Tan—failed.
units.literal: Meeting emperor died—consort feared younger imperial brother enthroned would make aunt-and-uncle relation—unable title empress dowager—hurried former crown prince Qinghe prince Tan enter—about establish—did not succeed.

units.zh: 懷帝即位，尊后為惠帝皇后，居弘訓宮。
units.en: Huai styled her Hui’s widow at Hongxun.
units.literal: When Emperor Huai ascended—honored consort as Emperor Hui’s empress—dwelling Hongxun Palace.

units.zh: 洛陽敗，沒于劉曜。
units.en: Luoyang fell—Liu Yao seized her.
units.literal: Luoyang fell—submerged by Liu Yao.

units.zh: 曜僭位，以為皇后。
units.en: Liu Yao usurped the throne and made her empress.
units.literal: Yao usurped throne—made her empress.

units.zh: 因問曰：「吾何如司馬家兒？」
units.en: He asked, “How do I compare to that Sima?”
units.literal: Therefore asked: “How compare to Sima house boy?”

units.zh: 后曰：「胡可並言？
units.en: She answered, “There is no comparison.
units.literal: Consort said: “How may they be spoken together?

units.zh: 陛下開基之聖主，彼亡國之暗夫，有一婦一子及身三耳，不能庇之。
units.en: You are a founding hero—he could not shield wife, son, self.
units.literal: Your Majesty founding sacred lord—that defeated-house dull husband—with one wife one son and himself only three—could not shelter them.

units.zh: 貴為帝王，而妻子辱于凡庶之手。
units.en: Emperor though he was—kin suffered common abuse.
units.literal: Noble yet emperor—wife and children humiliated by common hands.

units.zh: 遣妾爾時實不思生，何圖復有今日。
units.en: I thought life over—never dreamed of this dawn.
units.literal: Banished concubine then truly wished not live—how scheme again have today.

units.zh: 妾生於高門，常謂世間男子皆然。
units.en: Raised noble—I assumed every man so weak.
units.literal: Concubine born high gate—always thought world’s men all thus.

units.zh: 自奉巾櫛以來，始知天下有丈夫耳。」
units.en: Since serving you with comb and towel, I have learned that the world truly has real men."
units.literal: Since serving towel comb—begin know world has real husbands.”

units.zh: 曜甚愛寵之，生曜二子而死，偽諡獻文皇后。
units.en: He adored her—she bore two sons then died—honored posthumously as Empress Xianwen.
units.literal: Yao greatly loved favored her—bore Yao two sons then died—false posthumous title Offered Culture Empress.

units.zh: 謝夫人
units.en: Lady Xie
units.literal: Lady Xie

units.zh: 謝夫人名玖。
units.en: Lady Xie Jiu bore that name.
units.literal: Lady Xie named Jiu.

units.zh: 家本貧賤，父以屠羊為業。
units.en: Her father butchered sheep.
units.literal: House originally poor low—father by slaughtering sheep practiced craft.

units.zh: 玖清惠貞正而有淑姿，選入後庭為才人。
units.en: Pure and lovely—she entered as a talented lady.
units.literal: Jiu pure kind chaste upright possessing virtuous grace—selected rear chambers became talented lady.

units.zh: 惠帝在東宮，將納妃。
units.en: While Hui was heir they chose a princess.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui in Eastern Palace—about to take consort.

units.zh: 武帝慮太子尚幼，未知帷房之事，乃遣往東宮侍寢，由是得幸有身。
units.en: Wu, worried the crown prince was still young and did not know the affairs of the bedchamber, sent her to the Eastern Palace to attend him in bed—she conceived.
units.literal: Emperor Wu worried crown prince still young—did not know inner chamber affairs—therefor dispatched go Eastern Palace attend bedding—thereby gained favor pregnant.

units.zh: 賈后妒忌之，玖求還西宮，遂生愍懷太子，年三四歲，惠帝不知也。
units.en: Jia drove her west—she bore Minhuai—Hui knew nothing for years.
units.literal: Empress Jia jealous—Jiu begged return western palace—thereby bore Crown Prince Minhuai—age three four years—Emperor Hui did not know.

units.zh: 入朝，見愍懷與諸皇子共戲，執其手，武帝曰：「是汝兒也。」
units.en: Entering court and seeing Minhuai playing with the imperial sons, he took his hand and Emperor Wu said, "This is your son."
units.literal: Entering court seeing Minhuai playing with imperial sons—grasped his hand—Emperor Wu said: “This is your son.”

units.zh: 及立為太子，拜玖為淑媛。
units.en: When Minhuai became heir she became Shuyuan.
units.literal: When established crown prince—invested Jiu as Shuyuan.

units.zh: 賈后不聽太子與玖相見，處之一室。
units.en: Jia barred visits—penned mother and son apart.
units.literal: Empress Jia did not permit crown prince meet Jiu—housed one chamber.

units.zh: 及愍懷遇酷，玖亦被害焉。
units.en: When Minhuai died killers took her too.
units.literal: When Minhuai met cruel fate—Jiu also murdered.

units.zh: 永康初，詔改葬太子，因贈玖夫人印綬，葬顯平陵。
units.en: Yongkang reburied Minhuai—honored her at Xianping.
units.literal: Early Yongkang—edict reburied crown prince—thereupon granted Jiu lady seals—buried Xianping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 懷王皇太后
units.en: Empress Dowager Wang of Emperor Huai
units.literal: Empress Dowager Wang of Emperor Huai

units.zh: 懷王皇太后諱媛姬，不知所出。
units.en: Empress Dowager Wang Yuanji—parentage unknown.
units.literal: Empress Dowager Wang of Huai taboo Yuanji—birth unknown.

units.zh: 初入武帝宮，拜中才人，早卒。
units.en: She entered Wu’s harem as mid-ranked talented lady—died young.
units.literal: First entered Emperor Wu palace—invested Mid-ranked Talented Lady—died early.

units.zh: 懷帝即位，追尊曰皇太后。
units.en: Huai raised her posthumously to dowager.
units.literal: When Emperor Huai ascended—posthumously honored Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 元夏侯太妃
units.en: Lady Xiahou the Honored Consort of Yuan
units.literal: Grand Consort Xiahou of Yuan

units.zh: 元夏侯太妃名光姬，沛國譙人也。
units.en: Lady Xiahou Guangji came from Qiao in Pei.
units.literal: Grand Consort Xiahou named Guangji—native of Qiao in Pei.

units.zh: 祖威，兗州刺史。
units.en: Her grandfather Xiahou Wei governed Yanzhou.
units.literal: Grandfather Wei—Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 父莊，字仲容，淮南太守、清明亭侯。
units.en: Her father Xiahou Zhuang, courtesy Zhongrong, was governor of Huainan and Marquis of Qingming Pavilion.
units.literal: Father Zhuang courtesy Zhongrong—Huainan governor Marquis Qingming Village.

units.zh: 妃生自華宗，幼而明慧。
units.en: Noble blood—bright even as a girl.
units.literal: Consort born splendid clan—childhood bright intelligent.

units.zh: 琅邪武王為世子覲納焉，生元帝。
units.en: King Wu of Langya took her as wife for his heir Sima Jin, and she bore Sima Rui.
units.literal: Prince Langya Wu as heir apparent Jin married her—bore Yuan-di.

units.zh: 及恭王薨，元帝嗣立，稱王太妃。
units.en: After Gong died Rui styled her royal dowager.
units.literal: When Duke Gong died—Yuan-di succeeded—styled Wang Grand Consort.

units.zh: 永嘉元年，薨于江左，葬琅邪國。
units.en: She died in 307 south of the river—buried in Langya.
units.literal: First Yongjia year died south of Yangtze—buried Langya state.

units.zh: 初有讖云「銅馬入海建鄴期」，太妃小字銅環，而元帝中興於江左焉。
units.en: Prophecy called “bronze horse” to sea—her pet name was Bronze Ring—and Rui restored Jin south.
units.literal: At first prophecy said “bronze horse enters sea Jianye term”—grand consort childhood name Bronze Ring—and Yuan-di revived east of Yangtze.

units.zh: 晉征北將軍衛瓘以文帝雄異，恐為後患，請留不遣。
units.en: Jin's north-pacifying general Wei Guan, fearing Shamohan's formidable talent, asked that he be kept and not released.
units.literal: Wei Guan, General Who Subdues the North of Jin, because Wen Emperor was formidable and strange, feared he would be a later trouble and requested that he be detained and not sent back.

units.zh: 楊後被廢，賈后絕其膳八日而崩，葬街郵亭北，百姓哀之也。
units.en: Consort Yang died of Jia Nanfeng's hunger strike and was dumped by the courier station.
units.literal: Empress Yang was deposed; Empress Jia starved her eight days until she died; she was buried north of Jieyou post; the people pitied her.

units.zh: 南風，賈后字也。
units.en: Nanfeng was Empress Jia's style name.
units.literal: South wind" is Empress Jia's style name.

units.zh: 言賈后將與謐為亂，以危太子，而趙王因釁咀嚼豪賢，以成篡奪，不得其死之應也。
units.en: The gloss tied the verses to Jia's coup plot and Sima Lun's coming slaughter.
units.literal: It means Empress Jia would riot with Mi to endanger the heir, while Prince Zhao would chew up great men and seize the throne — an omen of dying badly.

units.zh: 晉武帝具禮護送。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Jin honored him with full ceremony and sent him homeward under escort.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin treated him with full rites and escorted him on his way.

units.zh: 宣皇帝諱懿，字仲達，河內溫縣孝敬里人，姓司馬氏。
units.en: Emperor Xuan had the personal name Yi and the courtesy name Zhongda. He came from Xiaojing Ward in Wen County, Henei Commandery, and belonged to the Sima clan.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan's taboo name was Yi; his courtesy name was Zhongda. He was a native of Xiaojing Ward in Wen County in Henei, and his surname was Sima.

units.zh: 魏武使人夜往密刺之，帝堅臥不動。
units.en: Cao Cao sent someone at night to stab him secretly, but Sima Yi lay rigidly in bed and did not move.
units.literal: Emperor Wu sent someone by night to stab him secretly; the Emperor lay rigid and did not move.

units.zh: 帝即防之第二子也。
units.en: He was the second son of Fang.
units.literal: The Emperor was Fang’s second son.

units.zh: 漢建安六年，郡舉上計掾。
units.en: In Han’s sixth Jian’an year the commandery recommended him as clerk for the capital assessment.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Jian’an of Han, the commandery nominated him as clerk for the annual accounts.

units.zh: 於是使與太子游處，遷黃門侍郎，轉議郎、丞相東曹屬，尋轉主簿。
units.en: Thereafter he was assigned to attend the crown prince, promoted to Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gates, transferred to Consultant and then aide in the Chancellor's Eastern Bureau, and soon made chief clerk.
units.literal: Thereafter he was assigned to attend the crown prince, promoted to Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gates, transferred to Consultant and then aide in the Chancellor's Eastern Bureau, and soon made chief clerk.

units.zh: 魏國既建，遷太子中庶子。
units.en: Once the Wei kingdom was founded he rose to palace attendant to the heir apparent.
units.literal: When the state of Wei was established, he was promoted to palace attendant to the heir apparent.

units.zh: 從討張魯，言於魏武曰：「劉備以詐力虜劉璋，蜀人未附而遠爭江陵，此機不可失也。
units.en: On the expedition against Zhang Lu he urged Cao Cao: “Liu Bei bullied his way into Yi through trickery; the Shu populace still mistrusts him while he reaches for Jiangling—do not let this opening slip.
units.literal: Accompanying the campaign against Zhang Lu, he said to Emperor Wu, “Liu Bei seized Liu Zhang by deceit and force; the people of Shu are not yet attached, yet he contests Jiangling from afar—this opportunity must not be missed.

units.zh: 每與大謀，輒有奇策，為太子所信重，與陳羣、吳質、朱鑠號曰四友。
units.en: In every grand council he supplied sharp schemes; the heir relied on him and paired him with Chen Qun, Wu Zhi, and Zhu Shuo as the “Four Friends.”
units.literal: Whenever major plans were laid he produced striking stratagems; the heir trusted and esteemed him, and with Chen Qun, Wu Zhi, and Zhu Shuo he was called the Four Friends.

units.zh: 少有奇節，聰朗多大略，博學洽聞，伏膺儒教。
units.en: Even young he revealed unusual steadfastness—acute, far-sighted, erudite, and steeped in the Confucian canon.
units.literal: In youth he showed uncommon integrity; he was bright and broad in strategic grasp, widely read and well informed, and devoted himself to Confucian teaching.

units.zh: 尚書清河崔琰與帝兄朗善，亦謂朗曰：「君弟聰亮明允，剛斷英特，非子所及也。」
units.en: Cui Yan of Qinghe, who served in the Secretariat, was close to his elder brother Sima Lang and told Lang, “Your brother combines lucidity with integrity and carries an iron decisiveness—you cannot rival him.”
units.literal: Minister Cui Yan of Qinghe was on good terms with the Emperor’s elder brother Lang and also said to Lang, “Your younger brother is clear-sighted and fair-minded, resolute and extraordinary—not someone you can match.”

units.zh: 自卬八世，生征西將軍鈞，字叔平。
units.en: Eight generations down from Ang came General Who Guards the West Jun, whose courtesy name was Shuping.
units.literal: Eight generations after Ang was born General Who Guards the West Jun, courtesy name Shuping.

units.zh: 鈞生豫章太守量，字公度。
units.en: Jun’s son was Liang, prefect of Yuzhang, courtesy name Gongdu.
units.literal: Jun fathered Prefect of Yuzhang Liang, courtesy name Gongdu.

units.zh: 量生潁川太守儁，字元異。
units.en: Liang’s son was Jun, prefect of Yingchuan, courtesy name Yuanyi.
units.literal: Liang fathered Prefect of Yingchuan Jun, courtesy name Yuanyi.

units.zh: 儁生京兆尹防，字建公。
units.en: Jun’s son was Fang, governor of Jingzhao, courtesy name Jiangong.
units.literal: Jun fathered Governor of the Metropolitan Region Fang, courtesy name Jiangong.

units.zh: 漢以其地為郡，子孫遂家焉。
units.en: The Han turned that territory into a commandery, and his line took root there.
units.literal: Han converted his territory into a commandery, and his descendants settled there.

units.zh: 其後程伯休父，周宣王時，以世官克平徐方，錫以官族，因而為氏。
units.en: Later, Cheng Bo Xiufu—during King Xuan of Zhou—used his hereditary charge to crush the Xu region and received a clan designation from his title; from that the Sima surname arose.
units.literal: Later Cheng Bo Xiufu, in the reign of King Xuan of Zhou, by virtue of his hereditary office conquered and pacified the Xu lands and was granted a clan name taken from his office; his descendants therefore took Sima as their surname.

units.zh: 其先出自帝高陽之子重黎，為夏官祝融。
units.en: The line descended from Chongli, son of Zhuanxu, who served as Zhurong under the ancient office of Xia.
units.literal: His ancestors traced their line to Chongli, son of Emperor Gaoyang (Zhuanxu), who held the office of Zhurong under the Xia.

units.zh: 漢末大亂，常慨然有憂天下心。
units.en: As Han unraveled, he was repeatedly consumed by anxiety for the empire.
units.literal: At the end of Han, when great turmoil arose, he often felt stirred with concern for the realm.

units.zh: 南陽太守同郡楊俊名知人，[1]見帝，未弱冠，以為非常之器。
units.en: Yang Jun of Nanyang—his fellow townsman and a celebrated judge of talent—met him before his cap-and-girdle ceremony and pronounced him a figure of rare promise.
units.literal: Yang Jun of the same commandery, prefect of Nanyang, famed for judging men,[1] met the Emperor before his twentieth year and deemed him an extraordinary vessel.

units.zh: 魏武帝為司空，聞而辟之。
units.en: Cao Cao, then minister of works, heard of him and summoned him to service.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Wei was Minister of Works and, hearing of him, summoned him.

units.zh: 帝知漢運方微，不欲屈節曹氏，辭以風痹，不能起居。
units.en: Knowing the Han house was in decline, he refused to bend himself to the Cao clan and pleaded crippling wind paralysis that kept him from rising.
units.literal: The Emperor knew Han’s mandate was failing and did not wish to bend his integrity to the Cao house; he declined on the grounds of wind paralysis and inability to rise.

units.zh: 及魏武為丞相，又辟為文學掾，敕行者曰：「若復盤桓，便收之。」
units.en: When Cao Cao became Chancellor he summoned him again as literary clerk and told the courier, “If he hesitates once more, seize him.”
units.literal: When Emperor Wu became Chancellor, he again summoned him as clerk for literature and instructed the messenger: “If he stalls again, arrest him.”

units.zh: 帝懼而就職。
units.en: Terrified, he accepted the appointment.
units.literal: The Emperor, in fear, took the post.

units.zh: 今若曜威漢中，益州震動，進兵臨之，勢必瓦解。
units.en: Show strength in Hanzhong and Yi province will reel; press forward and their front will collapse.
units.literal: If we now display our might in Hanzhong, Yizhou will be shaken; advance the army against it and it will surely crumble.

units.zh: 因此之勢，易為功力。
units.en: Ride that tide and the task becomes straightforward.
units.literal: Riding this momentum, success will come easily.

units.zh: 聖人不能違時，亦不失時矣。」
units.en: Even the sage neither fights the moment nor lets it pass unused.”
units.literal: The sage cannot defy the hour, yet neither does he miss it.”

units.zh: 言竟不從。
units.en: He would not take the counsel.
units.literal: In the end he did not follow the advice.

units.zh: 既而從討孫權，破之。
units.en: He later joined the campaign against Sun Quan and helped rout him.
units.literal: He then accompanied the campaign against Sun Quan and defeated him.

units.zh: 答曰：「漢運垂終，殿下十分天下而有其九，以服事之。
units.en: He answered: “The Han flame gutters while you hold nine parts in ten yet still bow to the emperor.
units.literal: He replied: “Han’s mandate is near its end; Your Highness holds nine-tenths of the realm yet still serves it.

units.zh: 權之稱臣，天人之意也。
units.en: Sun Quan’s offer to submit answers both Heaven and the human heart.
units.literal: Sun Quan’s submission accords with the will of Heaven and men.

units.zh: 虞、夏、殷、周不以謙讓者，畏天知命也。」
units.en: The sage-kings of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou yielded not from timidity but because they revered Heaven and accepted its mandate.”
units.literal: Yu, Xia, Yin, and Zhou did not yield out of mere modesty—they feared Heaven and knew the mandate.”

units.zh: 遷為軍司馬，言於魏武曰：「昔箕子陳謀，以食為首。
units.en: Promoted army marshal, he told Cao Cao: “When Jizi advised the king, grain came first.
units.literal: He was promoted to army marshal and said to Emperor Wu, “When Jizi presented his counsel, he put food first.

units.zh: 今天下不耕者蓋二十餘萬，非經國遠籌也。
units.en: Today more than two hundred thousand people are not farming; that is no long-range plan for governing the state.
units.literal: Today perhaps two hundred thousand men do not till the soil—this is no far-reaching policy for governing the state.

units.zh: 雖戎甲未卷，自宜且耕且守。」
units.en: Even while armor has not yet been put away, we should farm and defend at the same time.”
units.literal: Though armor is not yet laid aside, we should farm and defend at the same time.”

units.zh: 帝曰：「荊楚輕脫，易動難安。
units.en: He replied, “The Jing-Chu folk are restless—quick to bolt and slow to reassure.
units.literal: The Emperor said, “The people of Jing-Chu are flighty—easy to stir, hard to settle.

units.zh: 關羽新破，諸為惡者藏竄觀望。
units.en: Guan Yu’s fall leaves malcontents skulking in the shadows, watching.
units.literal: Guan Yu has just been defeated; those who meant harm hide and watch.

units.zh: 今徙其善者，既傷其意，將令去者不敢復還。」
units.en: Uproot the loyal now and you crush their hearts; refugees will never dare come home.”
units.literal: If we now relocate the good among them, we wound their feelings and will make those who flee dare not return.”

units.zh: 魏武納之，於是務農積穀，國用豐贍。
units.en: Cao Cao agreed; farming and granaries were stressed until state stores overflowed.
units.literal: Emperor Wu accepted this; agriculture was emphasized and grain stored, and state supplies grew ample.

units.zh: 帝又言荊州刺史胡脩粗暴，南鄉太守傅方驕奢，並不可居邊。
units.en: He further warned that Hu Xiu, inspector of Jingzhou, was brutish and Fu Fang, prefect of Nanxiang, was decadent—neither belonged on the border.
units.literal: The Emperor also said that Hu Xiu, inspector of Jingzhou, was brutal and coarse, and Fu Fang, prefect of Nanxiang, arrogant and extravagant—neither was fit to hold the frontier.

units.zh: 及蜀將關羽圍曹仁於樊，于禁等七軍皆沒，脩、方果降羽，而仁圍甚急焉。
units.en: When Guan Yu of Shu penned Cao Ren at Fan and Yu Jin’s seven corps vanished beneath the flood, Hu Xiu and Fu Fang duly defected to Guan Yu and the siege of Fan tightened unbearably.
units.literal: When Shu general Guan Yu besieged Cao Ren at Fan and Yu Jin’s seven armies were drowned, Hu and Fu indeed surrendered to Guan Yu, and Ren’s siege grew desperate.

units.zh: 帝諫曰：「禁等為水所沒，非戰守之所失，於國家大計未有所損，而便遷都，既示敵以弱，又淮沔之人大不安矣。
units.en: He objected: “Yu Jin’s men drowned—they were not routed in the field. The empire’s strategy is intact; relocating now advertises fear and panics everyone between the Huai and the Han.
units.literal: The Emperor remonstrated: “Yu Jin and the others were lost to water, not to defeat in battle or defense—the state’s grand plan is not yet harmed. To move the capital rashly would show weakness to the enemy and greatly unsettle the people between the Huai and the Han.

units.zh: 孫權、劉備，外親內疏，羽之得意，權所不願也。
units.en: Sun Quan and Liu Bei are allies in name alone; Sun Quan cannot relish Guan Yu’s triumph.
units.literal: Sun Quan and Liu Bei are outward kin but inwardly estranged; Guan Yu’s triumph is not what Quan desires.

units.zh: 可喻權所，令掎其後，則樊圍自解。」
units.en: Urge Sun Quan to stab Guan Yu in the rear and the ring around Fan loosens on its own.”
units.literal: You may instruct Quan to strike Guan Yu from behind; then the siege of Fan will lift of itself.”

units.zh: 是時漢帝都許昌，魏武以為近賊，欲徙河北。
units.en: The Han emperor still sat at Xuchang; Cao Cao judged it perilously near the foe and planned to shift the court north of the river.
units.literal: At that time the Han emperor was at Xuchang; Emperor Wu thought it too close to the enemy and wished to move the capital north of the Yellow River.

units.zh: 魏武從之。
units.en: Cao Cao adopted the plan.
units.literal: Emperor Wu followed this advice.

units.zh: 魏武以荊州遺黎及屯田在潁川者逼近南寇，[2]皆欲徙之。
units.en: Cao Cao meant to uproot the leftover households of Jingzhou and the military colonies in Yingchuan because both fronts skirted the southern enemy.
units.literal: Emperor Wu wished to relocate the remnant people of Jingzhou and the agricultural colonies in Yingchuan because they lay close to the southern foe.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Cao Cao relented.
units.literal: [Emperor Wu] followed this.

units.zh: 辛酉，左衛將軍王輿與尚書、淮陵王漼勒兵入宮，禽倫黨孫秀、孫會、許超、士猗、駱休等，皆斬之。
units.en: On the xinyou day Wang Yu and Prince Cui of Huailing forced the palace gates, seized Lun’s confederates Sun Xiu, Sun Hui, Xu Chao, Shi Yi, Luo Xiu, and others, and put them all to the sword.
units.literal: On the xinyou day, General of the Left Guards Wang Yu, together with the minister, Prince Cui of Huailing, led troops into the palace, captured Lun’s faction Sun Xiu, Sun Hui, Xu Chao, Shi Yi, Luo Xiu, and others; all were beheaded.

units.zh: 近不能開明刑威，式遏姦宄，至使逆臣孫秀敢肆凶虐，窺間王室，遂奉趙王倫饕據天位。
units.en: Near at hand I failed to make law and majesty clear enough to stop treason, so the rebel Sun Xiu could brutalize the court, tear at the royal house, and help Prince Lun of Zhao seize the throne by force.
units.literal: Near I have been unable to open and clarify punishments and might and check villainy and treachery, so that the rebellious minister Sun Xiu dared unleash cruelty and violence, spy on and divide the royal house, and thereupon supporting Prince Lun of Zhao greedily seized the heavenly position.

units.zh: 尚書漼共立大謀，左衛將軍王輿與群公卿士，協同謀略，親勒本營，斬秀及其二子。
units.en: Minister Cui framed the decisive plot; Wang Yu, general of the left guards, with the high ministers acting in concert, led their household troops into the palace and slew Sun Xiu together with his two sons.
units.literal: Minister Cui together established the great plan; General of the Left Guards Wang Yu, together with the host of dukes, ministers, and gentlemen, coordinated in stratagem, personally commanded the original camp, and beheaded Xiu and his two sons.

units.zh: 前趙王倫爲秀所誤，與其子等已詣金墉迎朕幽宮，旋軫閶闔。
units.en: The former Prince Lun of Zhao was deceived by Sun Xiu; he and his sons had already reached the Jinyong compound to bring me out of confinement and were turning their carriages toward the Changhe Gate.
units.literal: The former Prince Lun of Zhao was misled by Xiu; together with his sons and others he had already gone to Jinyong to welcome me from the hidden palace, turning the carriage at Changhe.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
